dct_title_s: Strategic map [of the United States]. NEW ORLEANS
dct_description_sm: War Dept., Corps of Engineers, U.S. Army.
Shows roads, railroads and air fields.
Issued chiefly in quadrangles 2* of latitude by 6* of longitude.
Begun as a WPA project and continued as AMS V401.
